mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn could cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies adjust to lower revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the labor market deterioration.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 70% of instances where UNRATE MoM > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real interest rates become more negative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as wage pressures and consumer spending increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE MoM < -0.1% and PAYEMS MoM > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related industries benefit from increased activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -0.5% and UNRATE MoM > 0.2%.
